datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule across Mauritania in 2017. Geographic polygons were classified according to IPC phases representing acute food insecurity severity, with multiple scenarios projected for near-term periods (February, June, October 2017).
